ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black (approx. 75-80%) with high-intensity white markings (approx. 20-25%) concentrated in linear streaks and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region occupying the central and lower lobe areas; high-intensity white/gray mottling at distal tips; dense network of high-intensity linear marks (white-on-black) distributed across the left and upper-central lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; edge profile shows significant jaggedness at distal tips corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curve along the leading edge tapering to sharp distal points; trailing edge shows a concave sweep from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent dark-ringed circular scars located on the upper right lobe; multiple smaller white circular clusters (likely barnacle attachment points) localized on the outer margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct cluster of 4-6 parallel vertical high-contrast white rake marks on the left lobe; multiple intersecting diagonal linear disruptions across the upper-middle region of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) visible on the extreme left and right distal tips, creating a highly textured and irregular silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity white 'splatter' pattern on the lower left lobe near the point of water contact.
